briefdescription.para: Polls the Tx status and waits for an indication that a frame has been transmitted successfully or a transmit related error has occurred.

detaileddescription.para: If an error is reported, it handles all the possible error conditions.

listitem.para: XST_NO_DATA if timeout or Tx failure.
XST_FIFO_ERROR if there is an error in the FIFO.

briefdescription.para: Polls the Rx status and waits for an indication that a frame has arrived or a receive related error has occurred.

detaileddescription.para: If an error is reported, it handles all the possible error conditions.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if a frame has been received.
XST_NO_DATA if timeout or Rx failure.
XST_FIFO_ERROR if there is an error in the FIFO.
XST_DATA_LOST if a frame has been dropped.
